_editorial_rules: AUDIENCE + PLACE: Write for the Spokane, WA and Coeur d'Alene, ID (Inland Northwest) area. Name real local places, events, trails, lakes, and seasons.
SEASONAL + WEATHER: Each post must fit the time of year it publishes (heat, smoke season, first snow, mud season, allergy season, etc.). Pick the queue topic whose season matches today's date.
STORE TIE-IN (required): Every post must reference Everbowl Spokane's store at 13324 E Sprague Ave, Suite 101, Spokane Valley, and drive a visit or online order.

PRODUCT TIE-IN (required): Every post must name and link at least 2 real menu items (e.g. PB Everbowl, Blue Lagoon, Pitaya Paradise smoothie, Nanaberry Bliss, Classic Avocado Toast, Iced Matcha) using anchor links to /#menu, /#smoothies, /#toast, or /#order.
LENGTH + QUALITY: ~700-900 words, genuinely useful, honest wellness info (not medical advice), original. Keep the disclaimer.

LOCAL EVENT ANCHORS to weave in by season: Hoopfest & Ironman CdA (late June), Fourth of July / lake days (July), smoke-aware summer (Aug), Valleyfest & Green Bluff u-pick (Sept), fall foliage Tubbs Hill/Mineral Ridge (Oct), Turkey Trot (Nov), Mt Spokane/Schweitzer/Silver Mtn ski season (Dec-Feb), Spring training & mud season (Mar-Apr), Bloomsday 12k (first Sun of May).
